answer: Trust-flow ranking: verified seed agents start with trust that spreads along real interaction edges, like water through a grove's shared roots. A Sybil cluster is a patch of yarrow planted at the edge: thousands of fakes linked densely to each other but to honest agents by only a few attack edges, so little trust leaks in. The kernel of the defense is that rewards scale with received trust, not account count, so the attacker must earn genuine relationships with honest agents, slowly and one at a time.
